description: Curated, original PubMed search strategies (one per condition and per major intervention family) and ClinicalTrials.gov condition terms. These are the ONLY search values the server may send to NCBI E-utilities or ClinicalTrials.gov (G5, G17). Queries verified live against PubMed (MeSH 2026 headings) on 2026-11-26; results are links for clinician review, not ratings of evidence.

pubmed.filter: (systematic review[pt] OR meta-analysis[pt] OR network meta-analysis[pt] OR randomized controlled trial[pt]) AND "last 10 years"[dp] NOT retracted publication[pt] NOT ((child[mh] OR adolescent[mh] OR infant[mh]) NOT adult[mh])
pubmed.filterLabel: Systematic reviews, meta-analyses and randomized controlled trials from the last 10 years. Retracted papers and child-only studies are excluded (adult scope).

panic-disorder.label: Panic disorder: treatment evidence
panic-disorder.query: "Panic Disorder/therapy"[mh] OR ("panic disorder"[tiab] AND (therap*[tiab] OR treatment*[tiab]))

generalized-anxiety-disorder.label: Generalized anxiety disorder: treatment evidence
generalized-anxiety-disorder.query: "Generalized Anxiety Disorder/therapy"[mh] OR ("Anxiety Disorders/therapy"[mh] AND "generalized anxiety"[tiab]) OR ("generalized anxiety disorder"[tiab] AND (therap*[tiab] OR treatment*[tiab]))

major-depressive-disorder.label: Major depressive disorder: treatment evidence
major-depressive-disorder.query: "Major Depressive Disorder/therapy"[mh] OR (("major depressive disorder"[tiab] OR "major depression"[tiab]) AND (therap*[tiab] OR treatment*[tiab]))

ptsd.label: Posttraumatic stress disorder: treatment evidence
ptsd.query: "Stress Disorders, Post-Traumatic/therapy"[mh] OR (("posttraumatic stress disorder"[tiab] OR "post-traumatic stress disorder"[tiab] OR PTSD[tiab]) AND (therap*[tiab] OR treatment*[tiab]))

social-anxiety-disorder.label: Social anxiety disorder: treatment evidence
social-anxiety-disorder.query: "Phobia, Social/therapy"[mh] OR (("social anxiety disorder"[tiab] OR "social phobia"[tiab]) AND (therap*[tiab] OR treatment*[tiab]))

obsessive-compulsive-disorder.label: Obsessive-compulsive disorder: treatment evidence
obsessive-compulsive-disorder.query: "Obsessive-Compulsive Disorder/therapy"[mh] OR (("obsessive-compulsive disorder"[tiab] OR "obsessive compulsive disorder"[tiab]) AND (therap*[tiab] OR treatment*[tiab]))

alcohol-use-disorder.label: Alcohol use disorder: treatment evidence
alcohol-use-disorder.query: "Alcoholism/therapy"[mh] OR (("alcohol use disorder"[tiab] OR "alcohol dependence"[tiab]) AND (therap*[tiab] OR treatment*[tiab]))

insomnia-disorder.label: Insomnia disorder: treatment evidence
insomnia-disorder.query: "Sleep Initiation and Maintenance Disorders/therapy"[mh] OR (("insomnia disorder"[tiab] OR insomnia[tiab]) AND (therap*[tiab] OR treatment*[tiab]))

cbt.label: Cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT)
cbt.query: ("Cognitive Behavioral Therapy"[mh:noexp] OR "cognitive behavioral therapy"[tiab] OR "cognitive behavioural therapy"[tiab]) AND "Mental Disorders"[mh]

exposure-therapy.label: Exposure therapy (in vivo, interoceptive, imaginal)
exposure-therapy.query: ("Implosive Therapy"[mh] OR "exposure therapy"[tiab] OR "in vivo exposure"[tiab] OR "interoceptive exposure"[tiab]) AND "Mental Disorders"[mh]

act.label: Acceptance and commitment therapy (ACT)
act.query: "Acceptance and Commitment Therapy"[mh] OR "acceptance and commitment therapy"[tiab]

dbt.label: Dialectical behavior therapy (DBT)
dbt.query: "Dialectical Behavior Therapy"[mh] OR "dialectical behavior therapy"[tiab] OR "dialectical behaviour therapy"[tiab]

motivational-interviewing.label: Motivational interviewing (MI)
motivational-interviewing.query: "Motivational Interviewing"[mh] OR "motivational interviewing"[tiab] OR "motivational enhancement therapy"[tiab]

emdr.label: Eye movement desensitization and reprocessing (EMDR)
emdr.query: "Eye Movement Desensitization Reprocessing"[mh] OR "eye movement desensitization"[tiab] OR EMDR[tiab]

prolonged-exposure.label: Prolonged exposure therapy (PE)
prolonged-exposure.query: "prolonged exposure"[tiab] AND ("Stress Disorders, Post-Traumatic"[mh] OR PTSD[tiab] OR posttraumatic[tiab] OR post-traumatic[tiab])

cbt-i.label: Cognitive behavioral therapy for insomnia (CBT-I)
cbt-i.query: "cognitive behavioral therapy for insomnia"[tiab] OR "cognitive behavioural therapy for insomnia"[tiab] OR CBT-I[tiab] OR ("Cognitive Behavioral Therapy"[mh] AND "Sleep Initiation and Maintenance Disorders"[mh])

relaxation-training.label: Progressive muscle relaxation and applied relaxation
relaxation-training.query: "progressive muscle relaxation"[tiab] OR "progressive relaxation"[tiab] OR "applied relaxation"[tiab]

erp.label: Exposure and response prevention (ERP)
erp.query: "exposure and response prevention"[tiab] OR "exposure response prevention"[tiab] OR "exposure with response prevention"[tiab]
